rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: OrnateCard component in OrnateElements.js was not passing the onClick prop to the underlying div element. The EventCard component was passing onClick={onToggle} to OrnateCard, but OrnateCard ignored it.
reproduction_steps: 3. Card would not expand (no Key Figures, Significance, Sources sections visible)
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Added onClick parameter to OrnateCard component and passed it to the div element: export const OrnateCard = ({ children, className = '', hover = true, onClick }) => ( <div ... onClick={onClick}>
